AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.title: Hive World Urchin
AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.description: Growing up on a hive world, [PAWN_nameDef] faced countless hardships from an early age. [PAWN_pronoun] had to fight for survival in the underbelly of the city, developing a strong will and a knack for combat. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the value of discipline and leadership in the face of adversity, traits that would later define [PAWN_objective] as a Commissar.

AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.title: Commissar
AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the legendary Commissar Yarrick, a beacon of hope and resilience in the face of overwhelming odds. Known for [PAWN_possessive] indomitable will and tactical brilliance, [PAWN_pronoun] has led countless campaigns against the enemies of the Imperium. Yarrick's iron discipline and fearsome reputation ensure that [PAWN_pronoun] commands unwavering loyalty and respect from those under [PAWN_possessive] command. Despite numerous injuries, including the loss of [PAWN_possessive] right arm and eye, [PAWN_pronoun] continues to fight with unyielding determination, embodying the very spirit of the Emperor's wrath.
